title: Major towns and cities, December 2015 (England and Wales, generalised, clipped)
description: The built-up area extents of the largest towns and cities in England and Wales, for placing a map in context rather than joining data to.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "Major_Towns_and_Cities_December_2015_Boundaries" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/Major_Towns_and_Cities_December_2015_Boundaries/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 112 features in WGS84. The portal serves this product through the API rather than as a named download, so the file is named for the layer and reproduced by rerunning that query rather than by filename.
